EndpointWorkflows.Name: Get Project Summary
EndpointWorkflows.Description: HTTP orchestration: project by key + active context.
EndpointWorkflows.WorkflowContent:
schemaVersion: '2'
kind: endpoint
name: 'Get Project Summary'
version: '1.0.0'
description: 'Load project by key then active context payload'
steps:
  getProject:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.QuickCodeModuleApi}}/api/quickcode-module/projects/get-by-key/{{input.key}}'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.QuickCodeModule}}'
    transitions:
      - condition: 'getProject.statusCode == 200'
        action: 'getContext'
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'fail'
  getContext:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.QuickCodeModuleApi}}/api/quickcode-module/project-contexts/get-active/{{getProject.response.id}}'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.QuickCodeModule}}'
    transitions:
      - condition: 'getContext.statusCode == 200'
        action: 'success'
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'fail'
output:
  projectId: '{{getProject.response.id}}'
  projectKey: '{{getProject.response.key}}'
  contextVersion: '{{getContext.response.version}}'
  contextStatus: '{{getContext.response.status}}'

EndpointWorkflows.Name: Get Order With Status
EndpointWorkflows.Description: Sync endpoint to fetch order status for portals.
EndpointWorkflows.WorkflowContent:
schemaVersion: '2'
kind: endpoint
name: 'Get Order With Status'
version: '1.0.0'
description: 'Fetch an order by id for seller/admin portals'
steps:
  getOrder:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.OrderManagementModuleApi}}/api/order-management-module/orders/{{input.orderId}}'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.OrderManagementModule}}'
    transitions:
      - condition: 'getOrder.statusCode == 200'
        action: 'success'
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'fail'
output:
  orderId: '{{getOrder.response.id}}'
  status: '{{getOrder.response.status}}'
  total: '{{getOrder.response.totalAmount}}'

EndpointWorkflows.Name: Project Studio Snapshot
EndpointWorkflows.Description: Complex endpoint sample: project → context (optional) → modules → analyses with branch on missing context.
EndpointWorkflows.WorkflowContent:
schemaVersion: '2'
kind: endpoint
name: 'Project Studio Snapshot'
version: '1.0.0'
description: 'Callable orchestration: resolve project → active context → module list → current analysis. Branches on missing context.'

variables:
  emptyModules:
    type: 'int'
    value: '0'

steps:
  getProject:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.QuickCodeModuleApi}}/api/quickcode-module/projects/get-by-key/{{input.projectKey}}'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.QuickCodeModule}}'
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    transitions:
      - condition: 'getProject.statusCode == 200'
        action: 'getContext'
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'fail'

  getContext:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.QuickCodeModuleApi}}/api/quickcode-module/project-contexts/get-active/{{getProject.response.id}}'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.QuickCodeModule}}'
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    transitions:
      - condition: 'getContext.statusCode == 200'
        action: 'loadModules'
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'loadModulesWithoutContext'

  loadModules:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.QuickCodeModuleApi}}/api/quickcode-module/project-modules/get-project-modules/{{input.projectKey}}'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.QuickCodeModule}}'
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    transitions:
      - condition: 'loadModules.statusCode == 200'
        action: 'loadAnalysis'
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'fail'

  loadModulesWithoutContext:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.QuickCodeModuleApi}}/api/quickcode-module/project-modules/get-project-modules/{{input.projectKey}}'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.QuickCodeModule}}'
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    transitions:
      - condition: 'loadModulesWithoutContext.statusCode == 200'
        action: 'successPartial'
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'fail'

  loadAnalysis:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.QuickCodeModuleApi}}/api/quickcode-module/project-analyses/get-by-project/{{input.projectKey}}'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.QuickCodeModule}}'
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    transitions:
      - condition: 'loadAnalysis.statusCode == 200'
        action: 'success'
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'success'

  successPartial:
    transitions:
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'success'

output:
  projectId: '{{getProject.response.id}}'
  projectKey: '{{getProject.response.key}}'
  projectName: '{{getProject.response.name}}'
  contextVersion: '{{getContext.response.version}}'
  contextStatus: '{{getContext.response.status}}'
  moduleCount: '{{loadModules.response.length}}'
  analysisCount: '{{loadAnalysis.response.length}}'

EndpointWorkflows.Name: Order Settlement Preview
EndpointWorkflows.Description: Complex endpoint sample: order → seller → commission models → payouts across marketplace modules.
EndpointWorkflows.WorkflowContent:
schemaVersion: '2'
kind: endpoint
name: 'Order Settlement Preview'
version: '1.0.0'
description: 'Portal callable: order → seller → pricing commission → finance payout preview. Multi-module chain with branching when seller is missing.'

steps:
  getOrder:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.OrderManagementModuleApi}}/api/order-management-module/orders/{{input.orderId}}'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.OrderManagementModule}}'
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    transitions:
      - condition: 'getOrder.statusCode == 200'
        action: 'getSeller'
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'fail'

  getSeller:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.SellerManagementModuleApi}}/api/seller-management-module/sellers/{{getOrder.response.sellerId}}'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.SellerManagementModule}}'
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    transitions:
      - condition: 'getSeller.statusCode == 200'
        action: 'loadCommission'
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'failNoSeller'

  loadCommission:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.PricingEngineModuleApi}}/api/pricing-engine-module/commission-models'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.PricingEngineModule}}'
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    transitions:
      - condition: 'loadCommission.statusCode == 200'
        action: 'loadPayouts'
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'fail'

  loadPayouts:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.FinanceSettlementModuleApi}}/api/finance-settlement-module/seller-payouts'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.FinanceSettlementModule}}'
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    transitions:
      - condition: 'loadPayouts.statusCode == 200'
        action: 'success'
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'success'

  failNoSeller:
    transitions:
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'fail'

output:
  orderId: '{{getOrder.response.id}}'
  orderStatus: '{{getOrder.response.status}}'
  orderTotal: '{{getOrder.response.totalAmount}}'
  sellerId: '{{getSeller.response.id}}'
  sellerName: '{{getSeller.response.name}}'
  commissionModelCount: '{{loadCommission.response.length}}'
  payoutCount: '{{loadPayouts.response.length}}'
